newsitem.title: FRANCE: French SFR sets new 35-40 mln franc ad campaign.
newsitem.headline: French SFR sets new 35-40 mln franc ad campaign.

text.p: SFR, the main competitor of telephone operator France Telecom in the French mobile phone market, said it was launching a new advertising campaign on Friday worth some 35 million to 40 million francs.
A spokeswoman at SFR, a subsidiary of Compagnie Generale des Eaux, said on Tuesday the campaign was being run by Publicis, which has previously handled SFR's advertising.
The campaign, which will run on television, in magazines and at the cinema, will last for seven weeks.

The spokeswoman said the campaign marks the launch of new tariffs for users of SFR's mobile phones which aim to expand its clientele from the professional market to the general public, particularly women, young people and older people.
SFR has set three new flat rates, adding rates for one hour and five hours of phone calls to its existing flat rate for three hours of calls.
The basic subscription fee for those paying call by call will also fall, to 95 francs a month from a current 99 francs, the spokeswoman said. The new rates come into force on Thursday.
